# Cystitis

**Authors:** Raymund Li, Stephen W. Leslie

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Cystitis refers to infection of the lower urinary tract, specifically the urinary bladder. It may be broadly categorized as either complicated or uncomplicated (simple). Uncomplicated cystitis refers to a lower urinary tract infection (UTI) in either men or non-pregnant women who are otherwise healthy. On the other hand, complicated cystitis is associated with risk factors that increase the likelihood and danger of the infection or the chances of failing antibiotic therapy.
